objective: Repackage the exact immutable v18 Phase 3 tensor payload under the separately construct-certified LayerCake v19 interface without changing tensor bytes, tensor values, tensor schema, architecture, tokenizer, router, residual geometry, guard, or signing identity. This first distinguishes whether the certified host mechanism alone transfers to the already signed endpoint before any 14-route successor is considered.
decision_rule: Pass packaging only if the v18 source signature and archive are bound, the source safetensors payload hash is d19e2548..., the v19 interface identity matches the external LayerCake construct, the architecture and tensor schema are unchanged, the rebuilt signed archive has exactly the same tensor-payload hash and torch-exact tensor values, and no training, calibration, teacher loading, candidate construction, or final access occurs.
next_gate_if_pass: Run exact 1,400-prompt ordinary-output conformance plus the frozen 400-prompt metamorphic suite through the same v19 package on CPU and CUDA before runtime promotion. Do not infer that the four-route endpoint reproduces the later 14-route adapted diagnostic.
claim_boundary: Exact v18-payload-to-v19 repackaging only; no output identity, prospective quality, runtime, stable frontier, matched baseline, final test, Phase 4 certificate, or ABI superiority claim.
